description:
The videos you kept with keep_find (long-form hooks and packages), newest decision
    first: one entry a video on each tab across all runs, or the kept finds of one run_id,
    limit 1 to 100 (default 100) per page.
    Returns {"kept": [...], "count": n on this page, "next_cursor"} with full find objects.
    Same shape as GET /v1/finds/keeps. Free. Errors: 422 for a bad kind, run_id or cursor.

kind.description: only "long" or only "packaging"; leave out for both
kind.title: Kind

name: list_kept_finds
